attchmntText: Divi's Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Divi's Laboratories Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 07, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The Board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated total income for the second quarter was Rs. 3,770 crores, up from Rs. 2,860 crores in the prior year. Profit before tax rose to Rs. 1,505 crores from Rs. 912 crores. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 1,127 crores compared to Rs. 689 crores previously. For the first half, total income was Rs. 6,907 crores. Profit after tax for the half year was Rs. 2,029 crores. The company reported a net forex gain of Rs. 20 crores. Capital work in progress stood at Rs. 1,638 crores as of September 30, 2026. Cash balances were Rs. 2,181 crores.
